bots.name: Hybrid v4
bots.description: One model bids, one chooses cards, and one guesses who holds the hidden cards. It tries its top 2 cards on 32 imagined deals built from those guesses.

bots.name: Kooz bot
bots.description: Look-ahead on models trained from scratch. It imagines 64 deals from its own guess model, tries every legal card, and only makes a Dash Call when its bid model rates it clearly worth it.

bots.name: Self-taught + guesses
bots.description: Self-taught + look-ahead with a second model of its own that guesses who holds each hidden card. It learned those guesses only from its own games, and imagines many more hands from them.

bots.name: Hybrid with Copycat cards
bots.description: Trained bot + look-ahead with its card model swapped for Copycat with practice. It keeps the original bidding model.

bots.name: Copycat with practice + look-ahead
bots.description: The practised model picks its 2 best cards, then Look-ahead tries them on imagined hands.

bots.name: Trained bot + look-ahead
bots.description: Trained bot's models choose which cards are worth considering. It then tries each one on imagined hands.

bots.name: Self-taught + look-ahead
bots.description: The Self-taught model bids alone and picks its best cards, then tries each one on imagined hands.

bots.name: Self-taught
bots.description: One trained model makes every decision. It began by playing randomly and learned only by playing itself, with no strategy written in and nothing copied.

bots.name: Copycat with practice
bots.description: Copycat's model, improved further by playing itself. It bids with Basic rules.

bots.name: Trained bot
bots.description: Two trained models, one for bidding and one for cards. It started by copying Look-ahead, then improved by playing itself.

bots.name: Copycat + look-ahead
bots.description: Copycat's model picks the most promising cards, so Look-ahead can spend its effort trying only those.

bots.name: Look-ahead
bots.description: Imagines what the others might hold, plays each card to the end of the round using Basic rules, and picks what scored best.

bots.name: Look-ahead, tuned rules
bots.description: Like Look-ahead, but it plays each card out with rules tuned for that job.

bots.name: Copycat
bots.description: A trained model that learned its card play by copying Look-ahead. It bids with Basic rules and does no look-ahead itself.

bots.name: Rules + trump count
bots.description: Basic rules, except it stops chasing tricks once its unbeatable trumps cover what it still needs.

bots.name: Basic rules
bots.description: Follows a short list of rules a person wrote.

bots.name: Cautious rules
bots.description: Basic rules, set to take fewer risks.

bots.name: Always lowest card
bots.description: A simple example bot. It never bids and always plays its lowest card.

bots.name: Always highest card
bots.description: A simple example bot. It never bids and always plays its highest card.

bots.name: Random
bots.description: Plays any legal move. It's the bottom of the scale.

bots.name: Claude Opus 5.5
bots.description: Anthropic's general AI model, not built for this game. For each move it reads the rules and its own view of the table in words, then picks one. It has no tools and remembers nothing between moves.
